notes: Sector label suggests consumer business, but St. Joe is mainly a real estate developer; facets reflect its consumer-facing hospitality, homes and leasing.

sub_sector.value: Northwest Florida real estate development; hospitality resorts; commercial leasing

product_category.detail: Residential homesites and homes, hotels and resorts, club amenities, leasable commercial space, brokerage, insurance and title services

market_position.detail: Watersound-branded Gulf Coast communities, resorts and elevated lifestyle retail, with some broader price points

distribution_model.detail: Sells land and homes directly, operates and leases hotels and venues; brands used under license by affiliates

purchase_frequency.detail: Home and land purchases are infrequent; hotel stays and events are occasional leisure spending
